electrical_specs.raw: HS400               : 200 MHz clock, Dual Data Rate on the 8-bit bus, with

design_parameters.raw: High Speed DDR      : 52 MHz, Dual Data Rate on 4/8-bit, 1.8 V/3.3 V.

signaling_summary: Digital protocol block; signaling is on the named external pins per the protocol specification.

io_supplies.VCC: NAND core / memory supply (3.3V or 1.8V class)
io_supplies.VCCQ: I/O and controller supply (1.8V or 1.2V class)

signaling: single-ended push-pull CMD/DAT; SDR up to HS200 (200 MHz), DDR (both CLK edges) for High Speed DDR and HS400; HS400 adds the device-sourced Data Strobe (DS) as a read strobe.
tuning: HS200/HS400 use SEND_TUNING_BLOCK (CMD21) to centre the read sampling point.
